sport_summary: Loaded 20-game Saturday slate featuring NBA Playoffs, NHL Playoffs, and a full MLB day card headlined by Paul Skenes on the mound in Toronto

picks.reasoning: Paul Skenes takes the mound for Pittsburgh — he's one of the best arms in the game and a near-automatic low-scoring start. Toronto counters with Patrick Corbin, a veteran ground-ball pitcher who keeps games tight. The Under 7.5 at -107 on LowVig carries a 179.8 edge_bps, well above our 100 threshold, beating a median of -115 by a substantial margin. Skenes vs. a below-average Blue Jays offense is a strong pitch-dominant setup.

Framber Valdez starts for Detroit — a proven frontline starter who gives the Tigers a significant pitching edge over Brandon Young, a less-established arm for Baltimore. The Tigers ML at +107 on BetUS shows 169.1 edge_bps against a median of +100, meaning books are significantly underpricing Detroit here. Valdez's ground-ball heavy approach is well-suited to suppress an Orioles lineup and grind out an upset.

The Under 9.0 at -102 on BetMGM registers 299.3 edge_bps against a median of -115 — the single largest pricing discrepancy on today's entire slate. Grant Holmes starts for Atlanta against Jake Irvin for Washington, a matchup of mid-rotation arms, but the consensus is sharply tilted toward the Under at this number. Getting nearly even money on a side the market prices at -115 is a rare opportunity that demands action.

Cleveland -2.5 at -105 on Bovada carries 116.1 edge_bps versus a median of -110, offering meaningful line value on the favorite. The Cavaliers are at home and the market consensus strongly supports their advantage at this spread. Getting the chalk at -105 instead of the standard -110 is a clear pricing edge worth pressing in a playoff setting.

George Kirby starts for Seattle — one of the most efficient contact-management pitchers in baseball — while Kansas City sends Stephen Kolek to the hill. The Under 8.5 at +100 (even money) on FanDuel shows 169.1 edge_bps against a median of -107, meaning you're getting significant positive value on a side the market prices as a mild favorite. Kirby's elite command and low walk rate consistently suppress run totals.

Roki Sasaki has shown inconsistency in his transition to MLB, and Robert Gasser is a mid-rotation arm for Milwaukee — this is a matchup where run-scoring is live. The Over 9.0 at even money on FanDuel carries 122.0 edge_bps against a median of -105, providing genuine positive-value pricing. Getting plus money on the Over in a game where neither starter is an elite run-suppressor is a smart play.

The Over 6.0 at +106 on LowVig.ag shows 96.1 edge_bps against a median of +102 — just under our strict 100 threshold but the positive American odds on an Over in a playoff game with two offenses capable of pushing pace makes this a calculated inclusion. Carolina is a dominant home team that can force open-ice hockey, and Montreal has shown offensive capability that can keep totals elevated. The positive price on the Over is the key driver here.
